title: Anti-coherence Regularized Absolute Scaling for Out-of-Distribution Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.32255v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is recognized as a critical problem in AI safety. SCALE is an effective post-hoc OOD detection method in the activation-shaping family that requires no training data and rescales penultimate activations using a percentile-based magnitude ratio. However, this ratio is ill-defined when negative activations are present, since positive and negative contributions cancel within the underlying sum, causing SCALE to degenerate on backbones such as ViT. We address this with an Absolute Fix that computes the ratio over absolute-valued activations rather than discarding negative activations through ReLU. Building on this corrected scale, we propose Anti-coherence regularization, which penalizes the scaling factor by the fraction of a sample's max-logit contributions to the max logit that are sign-mismatched and thereby suppresses unreliable evidence for the predicted class. translated_title: 面向分布外检测的抗相干性正则化绝对缩放方法
translated_abstract: 分布外（OOD）检测被公认为AI安全中的一个关键问题。SCALE是激活整形家族中一种有效的后处理OOD检测方法，它无需训练数据，并通过基于百分位的幅度比对倒数第二层激活进行重新缩放。然而，当存在负激活时，该比值定义不良，因为正负贡献在底层求和中相互抵消，导致SCALE在ViT等骨干网络上性能退化。我们通过一种“绝对值修复”来解决这一问题，即在绝对值化的激活上计算比值，而非通过ReLU丢弃负激活。基于这一修正后的尺度，我们进一步提出抗相干性正则化，通过惩罚样本中与最大logit符号不匹配的最大logit贡献占比，从而抑制对预测类别不可靠的证据。尽管无需访问训练数据……（原文摘要截断）
tldr: 提出绝对值缩放修复与抗相干性正则化，解决了SCALE方法因负激活正负抵消而在ViT等骨干网络上性能退化的问题，无需训练数据即可提升分布外检测性能。
en_tdlr: An Absolute Fix and Anti-coherence regularization address SCALE's degeneration caused by sign cancellation in negative activations, enabling training-free OOD detection without access to training data.
